caption: The drawing depicts a decorative rectangular frame with ornate embellishments. At the top center of the frame, there are overlapping shell-like fan motifs with radiating lines, flanked by circular floral elements. The sides and top of the frame are bordered by twisted, rope-like patterns. On each lower side, two large symmetrical, swirling shapes extend outward and upward, each adorned with floral details and dots. On both the left and right inner vertical edges, there is a candle held in a cup-shaped holder with a short cylindrical base, mounted on a small square with a sunburst or flower design at the corners. The lower center of the frame features additional scrollwork and floral motifs. The drawing is done in grayscale with shading to indicate depth and is composed of pencil and watercolor washes with highlights and shadows to show texture and dimensionality.
title: Tin Mirror Frame with 2 Candle Sockets
